title.narrative: Strengthening of urban revitalization and housing quality processes in the city of Bogota, within the framework of the New Urban Agenda and the Sustainable Development Goals

description.narrative: The project will be developed in the city of Bogota and focuses on two main axes, the first, in relation to the improvement of settlements, while the second, will focus on the quality of housing in the city, both issues handled by the District Secretariat of Habitat through its programs and plans. With respect to the improvement of settlements, the Secretariat is currently implementing 3 programs: the integral improvement of neighborhoods, eco-neighborhoods and urban acupuncture, which, through this project, are expected to receive specialized technical advice to analyze their scope and what their strengths and weaknesses have been and how to improve them, likewise establishing support in terms of governance guidelines, methodologies and legal aspects that will allow their continuity. In relation to the second axis, the project will focus on the analysis of the current housing conditions in the city, seeking to show which is the standard that is currently managed to see those aspects where there are major shortcomings, from there, conceptual quality guidelines will be provided according to sustainability requirements, integration of SDGs, New Urban Agenda and social inclusion, allowing different stakeholders and the secretariat to integrate into their projects better perspectives in relation to housing. This last axis will include the promotion of the standards set through a specific project of the secretariat, Lagos de Torca.
